subject: GDPR cross-border addendum — MSA redline harmonization & operational role split
messages:
From: Marta Kozlowski <marta.kozlowski@helioshealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@helioshealth.com
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 13:05:00 -0400
Subject: Initial: GDPR cross-border addendum for Redwood MSA / order form

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Procurement and legal at Helios asked us to send a consolidated language request for the Data Processing Addendum and any transfer-impact addendum that would sit alongside the MSA/order form. Specifically:

- We need an explicit controller/processor allocation for the new telemetry logs (they want processor-only treatment).
- Addendum language that ties fallback hosting (if EU hosting is temporarily unavailable) to a documented escalation and customer notification window.
- Confirmation on KMS boundaries and whether Redwood can support Helios-managed keys for production EU tenants.
- A copy of SCCs you propose (we attached our preferred version for reference).

Attached: Helios_Requested_DPA_Changes.docx and Helios_SCCs_Version.pdf. Can you confirm who from Redwood legal will own redlines and an expected review timeline? Procurement is targeting signature by end of month.

Best,
Marta
Marta Kozlowski
Head of Procurement
Helios Health

Attachments: Helios_Requested_DPA_Changes.docx (docx)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Kozlowski <marta.kozlowski@helioshealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 15:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Initial: GDPR cross-border addendum for Redwood MSA / order form

Marta —

Thanks for the detail and attachments. Looping in Ben and Karthik from Legal + Laura from Contracts so we can consolidate. Quick answers up front:

- Controller/processor allocation: we agree to document telemetry as "processor-only" for the customer-controlled telemetry streams; legal will propose precise clause language.
- Fallback hosting: ops/hosting policy currently permits temporary routing to non-EU regions under capacity failover, but we do not surface customer data for >72 hours without notice. Legal will draft a customer notification window and an operational escalation playbook to attach as an exhibit.
- KMS: we support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-KMS) for Dedicated and Private deployments; for hosted accounts we have a KMS integration plan we can offer as an appendix.

Ben/Karthik/Laura — can you take Helios' redline and propose a consolidated redline + a short rationale for any carveouts? If possible, can we turn this around in 48 business hours — Helios is aiming for EoM sign-off.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Head, Privacy & Policy
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 13 Apr 2028 09:40:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Initial: GDPR cross-border addendum for Redwood MSA / order form

Team —

I've reviewed Helios' requested changes. I put high-level notes inline in the attached consolidated redline (see summary below). Main points to confirm with Helios:

1) Telemetry/Logs: we can accept processor-only treatment for operational logs, but we need to preserve narrow lawful-basis language that allows us to process telemetry for debugging and service stability. Proposed language: "Processor shall process telemetry solely on Controller's instruction excluding aggregated service-quality metrics for Redwood's internal optimization; Redwood shall not use identifiable telemetry for model retraining without prior Controller consent."

2) SCCs: Helios attached an older SCC pack. We should propose the latest EU Commission standard clauses and include an explicit subprocessor list with routing controls. Attached: Redwood_SCCs_Proposal.pdf.

3) Fallback hosting and notification windows: suggest a tiered approach — immediate notification for outages >2 hours, operational mitigation updates at 24 hours, and mandatory written notice + remediation plan at 72 hours if EU hosting cannot be restored. We should avoid absolute guarantees on regional availability; instead offer contractual credits if the SLA is missed.

4) KMS: agree to support BYOK for Dedicated/Private. For Hosted, propose a migration path and ask Helios to accept a security appendix that lists supported KMS vendors and the timeline for enabling BYOK in their tenant.

I'll produce a single redline (MSA + Order Form + attached DPA addendum) and a 1-page risk memo for Sales/CS to review. Target: initial redline by end-of-day Fri.

Ben Carter
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Consolidated_Redline.docx (docx), Redwood_SCCs_Proposal.pdf (pdf)

From: Marta Kozlowski <marta.kozlowski@helioshealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@helioshealth.com
Date: Sat, 14 Apr 2028 08:55:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Initial: GDPR cross-border addendum for Redwood MSA / order form

Hi Neha / Ben —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the tiered notification proposal. A couple of follow-ups from procurement/legal here:

- Can you make the notification cadence explicit in the addendum (we want exact trigger times and content of notices)?
- Helios legal requests the latest SCC versions embedded rather than linked — embedding helps pass their internal audit.
- For BYOK, procurement wants a short table of supported KMS vendors + estimated time to enable for hosted tenants (they'll evaluate operational impact).

If you can get the redline and the 1-page memo into our DocuSign link by Monday EOD, procurement will greenlight the signature path. Otherwise they will ask for a 1-week extension on our side.

Thanks,
Marta

Marta —

Attached is the consolidated package: Redwood_Consolidated_Redline.docx (MSA + Order Form + DPA addendum), Redwood_SCCs_Proposal.pdf (embedded current SCCs), and a 1-page risk memo (Risk_Memo_Helios.pdf). Key callouts:

- Notification cadence: clauses 3.2–3.4 of the addendum include explicit triggers and sample notice templates (Immediate: within 2 hours; Update cadence: 24h, 48h; Escalation: 72h + formal remediation plan).
- SCCs: we embedded the current EU Commission standard clauses and added a short execution checklist for Helios auditors.
- BYOK / KMS table: included as Appendix B with supported vendors and an estimated 4–6 week enablement window for hosted tenants (faster for Dedicated/Private).

Next steps we propose:
1) Helios legal to review and confirm embedded SCCs are acceptable (please confirm by Tue EOD).
2) Procurement to confirm DocuSign route; we will accept the signature path if HubSpot/DocuSign matches the expected countersign sequence.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-7083

Thanks — looking forward to closing.

Neha Kapoor
